ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Child Process Of Wermgr.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious Windows Error Reporting manager (wermgr.exe) child process

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wermgr\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ipconfig\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\netstat\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nslookup\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\systeminfo\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\WerConCpl\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*LaunchErcApp\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-queuereporting.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-responsepester.*"))))
